posts.text:
Anthropic’s compute spending is increasing by 4x per year, outpacing OpenAI’s 3x.

Per its S-1, Anthropic spent $10 billion on compute and infrastructure in Q3 2026 alone, or $40 billion annualized, compared to $433 million in all of 2023.

posts.author: EpochAIResearch
posts.name: Epoch AI
posts.text: Most of Anthropic’s compute is used on R&D and other internal purposes, not on customer inference. Customer inference costs were around 26% of Anthropic’s compute spending in the first nine months of 2026, down from 38% in 2025.

Agentic inference capacity grew 4.6× from Q2 2025 to Q2 2026. This compares with just 2.6× growth in compute, according to our Inference Performance Index (IPI).
